result.instructions: Native library tools. Tool discovery lists available capabilities; unavailable legacy operations return explicit errors. The process is scoped to its configured library.

tools.name: kb_search
tools.description: Full-text search across the knowledge base wiki articles.

tools.name: kb_search_raw
tools.description: Fallback full-text search over the raw/ ingest directory (pre-compile source material). Use when kb_search misses — raw holds verbatim scraped sources, dictionaries, and book chapters that may contain exact wording lost during compile.

tools.name: kb_ask
tools.description: Ask a question against the knowledge base (deep research with context retrieval). Set promote=true to let the LLM judge whether to sediment the Q&A as a new wiki concept.

api_key.description: Per-request LLM API key override. HTTP callers MUST use the X-LLM-Key header instead; the /api/ask body is rejected with 400 if any api_key-like field is present.

tools.name: kb_get
tools.description: Get a wiki article by slug (alias-aware: accepts Chinese/pinyin/English names). Optional `section` param extracts just that section's subtree (heading + content + descendants); use kb_get_sections first to discover anchors.

section.description: Section anchor from kb_get_sections (e.g. h2-緒論-bb6572)

tools.name: kb_get_sections
tools.description: Get the section tree (table of contents) for an article. Each section has level, title, anchor, start/end character offsets, and nested children. Anchors are stable across cosmetic title edits and sibling reorders.

tools.name: kb_list
tools.description: List all wiki articles with titles and tags. Optional tag filter.

tools.name: kb_backlinks
tools.description: Find all articles that reference a given article.

tools.name: kb_taxonomy
tools.description: Get the hierarchical category tree of the knowledge base.

tools.name: kb_stats
tools.description: Knowledge-base statistics: article count, raw count, word count.

tools.name: kb_ingest
tools.description: Ingest a URL or local file path into the raw corpus.

tools.name: kb_compile
tools.description: Compile raw documents into wiki articles. full=true recompiles everything.

tools.name: kb_lint
tools.description: Run health checks on the KB. Legacy: fix=true delegates to kb_lint_fix.

tools.name: kb_lint_fix
tools.description: Auto-fix lint issues (metadata, broken links, duplicates, categories).

tools.name: kb_export_article
tools.description: Export a single article with full context (linked articles, backlinks).

tools.name: kb_export_tag
tools.description: Export all articles with a given tag.

tools.name: kb_export_graph
tools.description: Export the subgraph around an article up to a given depth.

tools.name: kb_export
tools.description: Legacy unified export (type: article/tag/graph). Prefer kb_export_article/tag/graph.

tools.name: kb_rebuild_index
tools.description: Rebuild the wiki index, aliases, backlinks metadata.

tools.name: kb_xici
tools.description: Get the guided reading (导读) — an LLM-generated introduction.

tools.name: compile_source
tools.description: Compile one raw source into reviewable drafts without accepting them.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Read the exact reviewed bytes and source revision of a compilation draft.

tools.name: apply_draft
tools.description: Accept a draft with an explicit compare-and-swap against its reviewed base hash.

tools.name: ask_sources
tools.description: Answer from original versioned evidence. Does not save or promote the answer.

tools.name: prepare_transcription
tools.description: Validate supplied transcript text and map it into a read-only native ask; does not perform OCR or model calls.

tools.name: ask_transcription
tools.description: Answer a supplied transcript using scoped original evidence; no source or answer writes. Images need a recognition adapter.

tools.name: save_answer
tools.description: Explicitly save an accepted answer with validated citations and visibility.

tools.name: get_saved_answer
tools.description: Read a saved answer and resolve its original evidence versions.

tools.name: promote_answer
tools.description: Judge a saved answer and optionally create a reviewable article draft; never applies it automatically.

tools.name: build_vectors
tools.description: Build or resume an embedding generation and activate it after complete snapshot validation.

tools.name: search_hybrid
tools.description: Fuse lexical and actual vector retrieval; explicitly reports degradation when vectors are unavailable.

tools.name: resolve_evidence
tools.description: Resolve an exact original passage and report whether it is stale or deleted.

tools.name: knowledge_graph
tools.description: Inspect a bounded graph of wikilinks and evidence-supported manual relations.

tools.name: article_backlinks
tools.description: List visible articles linking to one scoped article or unambiguous alias.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Read accepted classification or its explicit tag fallback in the requested language.

tools.name: set_taxonomy
tools.description: Accept a reviewed classification document with retained unknown metadata.

tools.name: generate_taxonomy
tools.description: Generate actual classification from scoped article metadata using the configured model.

tools.name: generate_introduction
tools.description: Generate and persist a guided introduction from a guarded source snapshot.

tools.name: generate_entities
tools.description: Extract people, events and places from guarded article context, with separate private output.

tools.name: repair_library
tools.description: Run an explicit maintenance stage with journaled changes and durable partial/failure status.

tools.name: run_job
tools.description: Execute at most one scoped queued job with a renewable durable lease.

tools.name: ingest_with_adapter
tools.description: Run one operator-configured external parser and accept its scoped source documents through the native journal.

tools.name: add_relation
tools.description: Accept a typed manual relation with original-version evidence supports.

tools.name: remove_relation
tools.description: Tombstone a manual relation while retaining its accepted revision history.
